 FOR SUBSCRIBERS Artificial intelligence Democrats won big on Election Day. But can they agree on AI?
 Democrats campaigned on concerns about AI and data centers, but competing priorities and opposition from the Trump administration could complicate efforts to enact new regulations. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Jon Ossoff in Atlanta on May 31. Ben Hendren / Bloomberg via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 8, 2026, 11:00 AM EST By Jared Perlo Democrats across the country who swept into power amid growing voter skepticism about AI and data centers are now reckoning with knotty discussions about how to tackle AI regulation and which technological impacts deserve their attention first, according to AI experts, strategists and legislators themselves.
